Nicki Minaj tells TIME she chose to go public with her support of Trump after her home became the target of multiple swatting calls and she felt ignored by Gavin Newsom — but then received help from Republican Congresswoman Anna Paulina Luna. 

On receiving help from Luna: “I was shocked, I’d never seen anyone in politics treat me that way. That’s what made me say that I don’t care to keep this a secret anymore”
